cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(influxdb_tsm_timestamp LANGUAGES CXX)
option(TSM_SANITIZERS "Address/undefined/leak checks" OFF)
option(TSM_TSAN "ThreadSanitizer in separate build" OFF)
if(TSM_SANITIZERS AND TSM_TSAN)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use separate sanitizer builds")
endif()
add_library(tsm_timestamp STATIC src/tsm_timestamp.cpp)
target_compile_features(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC include)
target_compile_options(tsm_timestamp PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -Werror)
if(TSM_SANITIZERS)
  target_compile_options(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(TSM_TSAN)
  target_compile_options(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(tsm_timestamp PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_executable(tsm_timestamp_cli src/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tsm_timestamp_cli PRIVATE tsm_timestamp)
include(CTest)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(tsm_timestamp_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tsm_timestamp_preflight PRIVATE tsm_timestamp Threads::Threads)
add_test(NAME tsm_timestamp_preflight COMMAND tsm_timestamp_preflight)
add_executable(tsm_timestamp_performance tests/performance.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tsm_timestamp_performance PRIVATE tsm_timestamp)
